about: The savings map in words. The console (SavingsMap.tsx on Overview) and the faxbot command (faxbot savings mechanisms, cli/commands/delivery.py mechanism_lines) both show exactly what the server says. The response is GET /routing/savings/mechanisms evaluated on a real synthetic installation (api/tests/test_savings_mechanisms.py scenario); its catalogue fields must match app/routing/mechanisms.py.

response.title: How Faxbot saves money
response.sentence: Every way Faxbot saves money, in the order a fax meets them.

legend.label: On or Off
legend.sentence: Whether it is switched on for your faxes.

legend.label: Works here or Not here
legend.sentence: Whether this installation has what it needs, such as its own phone line or a partner.

legend.label: Live call, Test lab or Sample data
legend.sentence: How far Faxbot has proven it: on a live carrier call, in its own test lab, or with sample data only.

mechanisms.name: Case packets
mechanisms.sentence: Leaves documents a recipient already accepted out of a case packet, so fewer pages are sent.

enabled.label: Off
enabled.sentence: No recipient accepts a list of the documents they already have yet.

mechanisms.name: Dense pages
mechanisms.sentence: Stacks short pages onto longer fax pages where the receiving machine allows, and leaves out blank page bottoms, so fewer pages and seconds are billed.
mechanisms.page_label: Delivery setup → Providers & accounts → Delivery routes

mechanisms.name: Encoded pages (experimental)
mechanisms.sentence: Sends a whole document as a few dense fax pages that the recipient's Faxbot turns back into the original, for recipients who agreed.

enabled.label: Off
enabled.sentence: No recipient has agreed to encoded pages yet.

mechanisms.name: Lighter shading
mechanisms.sentence: Lightens shaded areas and removes specks before a page goes on a line billed by time, so pages take less time to send.
mechanisms.page_label: Delivery setup → Providers & accounts → Delivery routes

mechanisms.name: Faxes to your own numbers
mechanisms.sentence: Delivers a fax to one of your own numbers straight into Received, with no phone call.
mechanisms.page_label: Delivery setup → Providers & accounts → Delivery routes

mechanisms.name: Direct delivery
mechanisms.sentence: Sends documents to verified partners over the internet instead of placing a fax call.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a verified partner; you have none yet.

mechanisms.name: Fax images to partners
mechanisms.sentence: Sends a partner the exact fax pages a call would carry, over the internet, with no phone call.

enabled.label: Off
enabled.sentence: Off while direct delivery is off.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a verified partner; you have none yet.

mechanisms.name: Send once and reuse
mechanisms.sentence: Sends a partner only what it lacks: one copy for several of its numbers, a reference to a document it already holds, or only the changes from the version it has.

enabled.label: Off
enabled.sentence: Off while direct delivery is off.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a verified partner; you have none yet.

mechanisms.name: Partner fax over a private tunnel
mechanisms.sentence: Places a fax call straight to a partner's fax engine inside your own encrypted tunnel, with no carrier and nothing per minute.

enabled.label: Off
enabled.sentence: Off while direct delivery is off.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a verified partner; you have none yet.

mechanisms.name: Partner relays
mechanisms.sentence: Sends faxes abroad through a partner that places them as local calls in its own country.

enabled.label: Off
enabled.sentence: Off until you and a partner both sign a relay agreement.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a verified partner; you have none yet.

mechanisms.name: Approved toll-free numbers
mechanisms.sentence: Dials a recipient's toll-free fax number once they approve it; the recipient pays for those calls.

enabled.label: On
enabled.sentence: On for 1 recipient who approved a toll-free number.

mechanisms.name: Cheapest route per delivered fax
mechanisms.sentence: Sends each number by the route that cost least per delivered fax once two routes have proven themselves.

enabled.label: On
enabled.sentence: On; a preferred route for a number still comes first.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a second sending route to compare with; you send through Telnyx only.

mechanisms.name: Your plan's faxes first
mechanisms.sentence: Uses a monthly plan while it has room under its budget, before routes that charge per fax.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a monthly plan among your sending routes; you send through Telnyx only, with no plan.

mechanisms.name: Calls at the right hour
mechanisms.sentence: Waits out a number's usual busy hours when a failed call there could be charged.

enabled.label: On
enabled.sentence: On; urgent faxes still go at once.

here.sentence: Faxbot keeps no count of the faxes that waited

mechanisms.name: Wait for a free line
mechanisms.sentence: Calls a number only while it has a free line, so a fax waits instead of paying for a busy call.

enabled.label: On
enabled.sentence: On; each number takes one call at a time unless you allow more.

here.sentence: Faxbot keeps no count of the faxes that waited

mechanisms.name: Direct messages and FHIR
mechanisms.sentence: Delivers to a recipient's confirmed Direct address or FHIR server instead of placing a fax call.

enabled.label: Off
enabled.sentence: No recipient has a confirmed Direct address or FHIR server yet.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a Direct messaging (HISP) or FHIR account; none is set up yet.

mechanisms.name: Fax over IP (T.38)
mechanisms.sentence: Carries fax pages as data over your SIP trunk, so pages go through faster than audio fax and calls are shorter.

mechanisms.name: Smallest page coding
mechanisms.sentence: Measures each fax's pages in every coding the call may use and sends the smallest, so pages take less time on the line.

mechanisms.name: Sending together
mechanisms.sentence: Sends several short faxes to the same number in one call, on a line that charges for each call.

mechanisms.name: Fewer separator pages
mechanisms.sentence: Marks each document in a shared call with an index page or a line on each page instead of a separator page.

enabled.label: Off
enabled.sentence: No recipient has agreed to an index page or page marks yet.

mechanisms.name: Faster pages
mechanisms.sentence: Sends pages over SSL Fax when the other fax machine offers it, so calls take less time.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs Faxbot's fax engine, which starts when you select Apply and connect on the trunk page.

mechanisms.name: Only the missing pages
mechanisms.sentence: Finishes a fax whose call broke by sending only the pages the call did not confirm.

enabled.label: On
enabled.sentence: On; you choose it for each fax whose call broke.

mechanisms.name: Missing pages to partners
mechanisms.sentence: After a broken call to a partner, sends only the pages the partner is missing, with no new call.

enabled.label: Off
enabled.sentence: Off while direct delivery is off.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a verified partner; you have none yet.

mechanisms.name: Charge checks
mechanisms.sentence: Matches what your carriers and fax services billed against your faxes, and points out charges and invoice amounts your faxes don't explain.

mechanisms.name: Junk callers turned away
mechanisms.sentence: Declines calls from blocked numbers before Faxbot answers, so they are never answered or received.

enabled.label: On
enabled.sentence: On for 1 number on your blocked list.

stages.title: Advice you act on
stages.sentence: Advice only: nothing changes until you act on it.

mechanisms.name: Cheaper routes per number
mechanisms.sentence: Names numbers whose usual route cost more per delivered fax than another, with a button to switch.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a second sending route to compare with; you send through Telnyx only.

mechanisms.name: Plans worth their fee
mechanisms.sentence: Says whether each monthly plan, such as an unlimited fax plan, is worth its fee at your traffic.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a monthly plan; none of your fax services has one.

mechanisms.name: Receiving lines and numbers
mechanisms.sentence: Says which of your numbers could share lines on your trunk, and which quiet numbers cost more to keep than they bring in.

mechanisms.name: Other carriers' prices
mechanisms.sentence: Prices your last 30 days of faxes at each carrier's published prices, so you can see what switching would change.

mechanisms.name: Calls just past a billed minute
mechanisms.sentence: Finds numbers whose calls end just past a billed minute, where one page less or a faster mode would cost less.

mechanisms.name: Partner candidates
mechanisms.sentence: Names the numbers whose faxes cost the most again and again, so you can enroll them as direct partners.

mechanisms.name: Recipients that run Faxbot
mechanisms.sentence: Finds recipients whose fax line is answered by a Faxbot, so you can send to them with no call.

mechanisms.name: Partners that could relay
mechanisms.sentence: Names partners whose signed local price would have cost less than your own calls.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a verified partner; you have none yet.

mechanisms.name: Toll-free numbers on file
mechanisms.sentence: Lists recipients with a toll-free fax number, so you can record their approval and stop paying for those calls.

mechanisms.name: Fax marker on calls
mechanisms.sentence: Compares calls marked as fax with calls that were not, on delivery and cost per delivered fax.

mechanisms.name: Time lighter shading would save
mechanisms.sentence: While Lighter shading is set to Never, measures your recent faxes and says how much time it would have saved.

mechanisms.name: Your trunks compared
mechanisms.sentence: Compares your trunks' monthly fees and busy times, and says when one trunk's faxes fit on another.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs two or more trunks to compare; you have one.

mechanisms.name: Where each number should live
mechanisms.sentence: Says where each of your fax numbers costs least to receive on, and the steps to move it.

mechanisms.name: Calls by state
mechanisms.sentence: Says whether your carriers price US calls by state, and when another site's trunk would cost less.

mechanisms.name: Caller-name lookup
mechanisms.sentence: Shows which of your Telnyx numbers pay for caller-name lookup, which Faxbot never uses, so you can turn it off.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs your Telnyx key saved on the Telnyx page.

mechanisms.command: faxbot delivery providers trunk telnyx names

mechanisms.name: Suggested packs
mechanisms.sentence: Gathers the settings and rules that would save money here into packs you review and apply.
